signals.name: Capex vs. operating cash flow
signals.reads: Above 100%, the buildout needs outside money to continue.
signals.detail: Core hyperscalers, trailing 12 months, rising vs. two quarters ago. Canaries: ORCL 1.61x (2026Q3); CRWV 2.98x (2026Q2)

signals.name: Debt-funded builders vs. the market
signals.reads: Markets price funding stress at the levered edge before filings show it.
signals.detail: Worst 63-day relative return. ORCL -13% vs. QQQ, -63% from relative high; CRWV -22% vs. QQQ, -51% from relative high. Prices as of 2026-09-22

signals.name: Share of capex funded by new debt
signals.reads: Confirms signal 1: is borrowing filling the gap?
signals.detail: Change in core gross debt over 12 months as a share of 12-month capex, rising two quarters running. CRWV debt +185% y/y. Excludes leases and off-balance-sheet vehicles; see filings below.

signals.name: Supplier growth and inventory
signals.reads: The earliest fundamental sign that orders are slowing or being stretched.
signals.detail: NVDA data center segment growth, 2026Q2. Not decelerating two quarters running. Inventory days 119 and rising. Receivable days 60.

signals.name: Cloud revenue growth vs. capex growth
signals.reads: The central question, but a gap is normal early in a buildout.
signals.detail: Cloud revenue +34% vs. capex +76%, trailing 12 months y/y, 2026Q2 (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN). Revenue has trailed capex 10 quarters running. A gap alone means an early buildout, not failure, so this signal caps at watch.

signals.name: Capex vs. depreciation
signals.reads: Not a stress detector: shows how large the coming depreciation wave is.
signals.detail: Core hyperscalers, trailing 12 months. The higher this runs, the more future earnings absorb today's spending.

signals.name: GPU rental pricing
signals.reads: Real-time oversupply signal. Coming in phase 2.
signals.detail: Planned: weekly H100 and B200 hourly price snapshot, tracked by generation.

signals.name: Depreciation-life changes
signals.reads: Extending lives flatters earnings; shortening concedes faster obsolescence.
signals.detail: Filings in the lookback window that mention a change in estimated useful lives. Read them: a match is a prompt, not a verdict.
